# BASE-ics 3
Clearly one step is too little.
I must combine multiple encodings to make it impossible to solve!

```

```

## Helpful Site
[CyberChef](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/)

## Solution
This looked like a base that wasn't the common ones (2, 16, 64), so I tried other ones. Since the text doesn't have lowercase alphabetic characters, it was likely to be something less than 64. I tried base32, then spammed the magic wand in (CyberChef)[https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=From_Base32('A-Z2-7%3D',true)From_Octal('Space')From_Hex('Space')&], which automatically figures out the next layers of encoding.

Flag: `gigem{Some_Sites_Make_Life_Easy_0xBEEFBEEF}`
